discoveries.line:
[QA-001] [UC-BuildSite] Non-string `name` (0, false, array, object) passes validation and renders as `

0

`, `

false

`, `

a

`, `

[object Object]

`
discoveries.repro:
1. Write content.json {"name":{"a":1}} (also 0, false, ["a"]). 2. CONTENT_FILE=content.json OUT_DIR=out node build.mjs. 3. Exit 0; out/index.html has

[object Object]

and [object Object].

discoveries.line: [QA-002] [UC-BuildSite] Whitespace-only `name` is accepted as present, giving an empty-looking h1 and title
discoveries.repro:
1. content.json {"name":" "}. 2. CONTENT_FILE=content.json OUT_DIR=out node build.mjs. 3. Exit 0;

and , no NAME_MISSING.

discoveries.line: [QA-003] [UC-BuildSite] `url` is escaped but not scheme-checked: `javascript:` url becomes a live link, and a whitespace-only url renders `<a href="   ">` instead of plain text
discoveries.repro: 1. content.json {"name":"A","projects":[{"title":"t","url":"javascript:alert(1)"}]}. 2. Run build with CONTENT_FILE/OUT_DIR. 3. Output has . Repeat with url " ": t.

discoveries.line:
[QA-004] [UC-BuildSite] Wrong-typed or empty optional fields render garbage silently: `contact.email` object gives `mailto:[object Object]`, `about` array gives `a,b`, and a project entry that is null, a number, a string or `{}` gives an empty `

`; a project with url and no title gives an empty link ``
discoveries.repro:
1. content.json {"name":"E","about":["a","b"],"contact":{"email":{"x":1}},"projects":[null,5,{},"str"]}. 2. Run build with CONTENT_FILE/OUT_DIR. 3. Exit 0; mailto:[object Object],

a,b

, four empty
cards.

discoveries.line: [QA-005] [UC-BuildSite] Control characters pass through unescaped: a NUL byte or newline in `name` reaches the output HTML (newline lands inside <title>); a 1 MB `about` is emitted without limit
discoveries.repro: 1. content.json built with JSON.stringify({name:"N\u0000x\u202e", about:"a".repeat(1e6)}). 2. Run build. 3. Exit 0, output is 1000591 bytes and contains a raw U+0000. With name "l1\nl2", <title> spans two lines.

discoveries.line: [QA-006] [UC-BuildSite] UTF-8 BOM content file is rejected as CONTENT_INVALID_JSON (common for files saved by Windows editors); a build that fails leaves the previous dist/index.html in place, so a stale page can be deployed after a failed build
discoveries.repro: 1. printf '\xef\xbb\xbf{"name":"F"}' > c.json; CONTENT_FILE=c.json OUT_DIR=out node build.mjs -> exit 1, CONTENT_INVALID_JSON, 'Unexpected token'. 2. Build a valid file into out/, then build {} into the same OUT_DIR: exit 1 and out/index.html still holds the old page.

discoveries.line: [QA-007] [UC-BuildSite] Unspecified path failures are not covered by the one-line error contract: OUT_DIR pointing at an existing file crashes with a raw Node stack trace (EEXIST) instead of a coded one-line stderr; OUT_DIR set to empty string silently falls back to dist/
discoveries.repro: 1. touch afile; echo '{"name":"P"}' > c.json. 2. CONTENT_FILE=c.json OUT_DIR=afile node build.mjs -> exit 1 with a multi-line 'node:fs ... Error: EEXIST: file already exists, mkdir' trace. 3. CONTENT_FILE=c.json OUT_DIR= node build.mjs writes ./dist/index.html.
